gcp.network.inter_zone.note: Data transfer to a different zone in the same region within one VPC network, charged to the sender. One price in every region: the Billing Catalog's single SKU (Compute Engine, Network Inter Zone Data Transfer Out) lists only us-central1, us-east1, us-west1, asia-east1 and europe-west1, so it is read in us-central1 for all. Synced from the Billing Catalog.
